purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Sibu

queries.query: Sibu Malaysia official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry Sarawak JUPEM
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Sarawak Land and Survey Department, its eLASIS public portal, and a Sibu-specific official district page. eLASIS documents cadastral map products and Mobile LASIS land search/map layers; anonymous parcel-vector download was not exposed in the reviewed public pages.

queries.query: Sibu Malaysia peta kadaster lot tanah rasmi Sarawak JUPEM
queries.result: Malay-language/official discovery identified JUPEM cadastral products and the Sarawak eLASIS cadastral-map service. The reviewed eLASIS material describes cadastral boundaries, lot numbers, and Timbalai 1948 / RSO Borneo Meters for cadastral sheets; no anonymous parcel geometry response was obtained.

registryEvidence.custodian: Land and Survey Department Sarawak (Jabatan Tanah dan Survei Sarawak), through eLASIS/LASIS; the official Sibu page lists Sibu Town District and other Sibu land districts.
registryEvidence.locality: Sibu, Sarawak, Malaysia; official Sibu district and Sibu Town District pages were reviewed.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: Local/state cadastral custody and public map/product procedures are evidenced. Open parcel-vector coverage and a safe anonymous parcel API for Sibu are not established.

officialSources.observation: Official Sibu page lists Sibu District land districts, including SIBU TOWN DISTRICT and SEDUAN LAND DISTRICT.
Official page describes Mobile LASIS as Sarawak Land and Survey Department's public land-search/map service, including search by parcel identifier or coordinates and lot-boundary/labelling layers.
Official eLASIS page describes cadastral map sheets showing survey-lot boundaries and lot numbers; it states Timbalai 1948 and RSO Borneo Meters for the cadastral sheet product.
Official eLASIS portal exposes eMap cadastral products and eSearch land-registry products; current public access requires SarawakPass for services.
Official/current national UPI ArcGIS service metadata returned Admin1-Admin4 polygon layers in EPSG:4326, not parcel layers.

parcelDiscovery.source: Sarawak Land and Survey Department/eLASIS public pages; bounded myGOS UPI service inspection
parcelDiscovery.crs: eLASIS cadastral sheets document Timbalai 1948 / RSO Borneo Meters; the inspected myGOS UPI administrative service reports EPSG:4326. No parcel geometry was returned to validate parcel CRS.
parcelDiscovery.boundedResponse: The inspected UPI service exposed only Admin1-Admin4 administrative polygons. An exact WUP-point intersects query against Admin4 with outFields OBJECTID_1, GlobalID, FCD and returnGeometry=true returned an empty feature array; this was not a parcel query and is not evidence of citywide absence.
parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted. No parcel polygon or source-specific attribute set is retained.
